title: Story pack: how soon do you judge a new ad?
hook: A new ad looks costly in week one. When do you switch it off?
caption:
Story pack (no feed caption).

Frame 1 asks the question. Frame 2 is the poll. Frame 3 is the number from our analysis. Frame 4 is the tip to copy: write the review date before launch. Frame 5 points to tomorrow's Decoded issue on creative fatigue.
alt_text: Five vertical story frames in Galvor violet and gold. Frame 1 asks how soon you judge a new ad. Frame 2 is a poll on when you switch off a costly new ad. Frame 3 shows 35%: some ad styles start about 35% dearer per order in their first two months and end close to average. Frame 4 gives the tip: write the review date before launch. Frame 5 says Decoded #6 on creative fatigue lands tomorrow.
cta: Vote in the poll; follow @galvor.ai for tomorrow's Decoded #6

slides.headline: How soon do you *judge* a new ad?
A new ad looks costly. When do you *switch it off?*
Some ad styles start about 35% *dearer per order* in their first two months
slides.sub: They end close to average over their life.
slides.source: Source: Galvor analysis · ads launched May–Sep 2026

slides.headline: Write the *review date* before launch
slides.body:
Decide the day you will judge the ad, and the cost you expect by then.

On its own, a costly first week tells you little. The date keeps the decision honest.

slides.sub: When to refresh, when to cut.
